author: Collin Times
title: Keith Self addresses national debt and federal program reforms in December posts - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman who secured re-election in 2024 with 62.5% of the vote against Sandeep Srivastava, posted a series of statements on his social media account on December 1, 2025, addressing issues ranging from national debt to government programs and cultural values.
In his first post at 15:08 UTC, Rep. Self highlighted concerns about the national debt and fiscal responsibility, stating: “Every American needs to read this article. America is $38 trillion in the hole and still pretending to be immune because of the U.S. dollar. The UK just showed us our future if Congress keeps kicking the can down the road. Now is the time to choose: serious spending” (December 1, 2025).
Later that day at 16:07 UTC, he commented on cultural values by writing: “Sharia is an affront to everything we stand for as Americans.” (December 1, 2025).
At 17:27 UTC, Rep. Self addressed government assistance programs with a focus on oversight and eligibility requirements: “SNAP is riddled with fraud, waste, and abuse. Reforming it—and all other USDA programs—begins with one ironclad rule: zero taxpayer dollars for illegal aliens. Thank you, @POTUS and @SecRollins.” (December 1, 2025).
Rep. Self has consistently advocated for conservative fiscal policies throughout his political career. He previously defeated Sandeep Srivastava in both the 2022 general election with approximately 60.5% of the vote and again in 2024 with an increased margin of victory.
